items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Rex Stewart boy, he wanted to get to Louis, you know. And he got up on the stand and tried to hit a high note and he missed it and I hollered.

ctx.x: Louis asked me, he said, how do you get along with Pops? I said, I get along fine with him. I said, we've never had one cross word in our life. And then I told him the little thing that happened at the Lenox Club that night. The night we'd taken May McKinney?) out to the after hours place. And Rex Stewart boy, he wanted to get to Louis, you know. And he got up on the stand and tried to hit a high note and he missed it and I hollered. And old Louis said, "look out there face. A little professional courtesy."…
